items.title: M&G (LSE:MNG) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Fine Tune Targets
items.summary: M&G is back in focus after analysts nudged fair value estimates higher, with the central model move taking the figure from £3.09 to £3.19 per share. Recent research, including commentary from JPMorgan, has seen price targets cluster in a tight £2.95 to £3.35 range. This keeps the discussion firmly on fine tuning valuation rather than calling for a big rerating. As you read on, you will see how these shifts fit into the broader M&G story and what to watch as the analyst narrative...
